evidence.title: On the Applicability of Safety Nets: A Safety-By-Design Solution for Certifying Neural Networks

summary: Researchers have introduced a safety‑by‑design methodology called “Safety Nets” that provides formal guarantees for neural network behavior. The approach combines verification techniques with design‑time safeguards, offering a practical path toward certifying AI systems for high‑risk applications.
title: New Safety‑By‑Design Framework Enables Formal Certification of Neural Networks
